name: liveyaku-helper
description: LiveYaku local helper: translation pipeline PoC (see /docs/steam-jp-realtime-translation-blueprint.md). The real Windows-native hook-injector/hook-dll (DLL injection into game processes) is NOT implemented here — this sandbox cannot build or run Windows-native code. capture/mockCaptureSource.ts stands in for it.
